title: Auto Trading Evidence Machine / Next Empirical Phase
question: Is the evidence machine now clean enough to test economic hypotheses, and which 2-3 existing hypotheses deserve scarce forward-test capacity?
hypothesis: After PIT/data-plane repairs, the highest-value next step is selective falsification of a very small hypothesis set, not more theory generation or execution architecture.
baseline: Current data-plane, leakage controls, immutable trial denominator and existing theory ledger under the rule that history may kill while clean forward evidence confirms.
required_analysis: Assess readiness of the evidence plane before ranking alpha hypotheses.
Penalize hypotheses for multiple testing, overlap, poor power, fragile data and high forward-calendar cost.
Rank existing hypotheses by value of information, falsifiability, expected learning per unit time and duplication risk.
Select at most 2-3 candidates only if evidence infrastructure is ready.
Design frozen preregistration skeletons and explicit kill criteria.
Prefer retiring hypotheses to generating new ones.
falsifier: The evidence plane remains insufficiently point-in-time/replay-safe, or no existing hypothesis clears the opportunity-cost and multiple-testing hurdle.
kill_condition: If readiness fails, do not select candidates. If no hypothesis has sufficient value of information, close with BUILD_NOTHING.
